name: chrome-profile-launcher
title: Chrome Profile Launcher
description: Open any Google Chrome profile in a new window without switching virtual desktops.
author: sanjan_sen

commands.name: open-profile
commands.title: Open Chrome Profile
commands.description: open profile in your current desktop without switching

commands.name: menu-bar-profiles
commands.title: Chrome Profiles Menu Bar
commands.description: launch a Chrome profile from the menu bar without opening Raycast

commands.name: launch-profile
commands.title: Launch Profile
commands.description: launch a specific Chrome profile by name (for quicklinks and global hotkeys)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
